This is a demo of the two trees of ui-components, showing a tree of life: fungi, animals and plants, some of their groups, a few long extinct, and some of their species, the way from the animals to the dinosaurs expanded.
  • On the left, Tree: a tree of Wicket components, a NestedTree of wicket-extensions whose nodes render the icons of ui-components, inline SVG drawn for the trees, instead of the images of the extensions' themes. Expanding a group repaints it through Ajax
  • In the middle, JsonBasedTree: a single component without children, whose nodes are rendered in the browser from JSON with a template, as the rows of the JSON table are. The kingdoms and the children of the groups expanded come with the page; the children of another group come from the tree's own endpoint the first time it is expanded. The tree is told what the user expands, so it shows the same groups when it is rendered again
  • Groups are selected as well as species, as both trees are told with setSelectBranches(true): click a group, such as the dinosaurs, and its card is shown on the right, repainted through Ajax by onSelect, the group expanded if it was not. Click a species, such as Tyrannosaurus rex, and the right shows its lineage, from the kingdom down, the card of its group and, below it, the card of the species. The arrow of a group still only expands or collapses it
  • JsonBasedTree is a WAI-ARIA tree: Tab to it, then Up and Down move between the nodes, Right expands a group or moves to its first child, Left collapses it or moves to its parent, Home and End go to the first and the last node, and Enter or Space selects a group or a species. In Tree, Tab moves between the nodes, which are buttons telling whether their group is expanded
  • The names, the descriptions, the ranks, the periods and the times are written in the language of the session; switch to German or Spanish to see them change, together with the texts of the trees, which are in the bundles of ui-components
  • "Icons" above the trees chooses their icons: their own, the Font Awesome icons as inline SVG (SvgIcon), or the same drawn by the Font Awesome font (FontAwesomeIcon), given to the trees with setIcon(TreeIcon, IIcon). The arrows of the groups turn whatever icon they are; the React and Svelte tabs choose them the same way, through the icons of their trees

The React and Svelte tabs show the same tree in the Tree of @antilia/react and @antilia/svelte, with the prop selectBranches. The tree comes from the mounted resource /api/tree-of-life, the children of a group from /api/tree-of-life?parent=id, and the cards of what is selected are shown by the app itself. Ma stands for millions of years ago.
